hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was stitching a linen sheet by the tallow candlelight when I heard footsteps. I froze, my needle trembling. The master's voice grew louder, and I ducked behind a curtain. He passed, but I could still feel his eyes upon me.
caption:
Caught in the dim glow of candlelight, Betty Ryal hides behind a curtain in the manor's corridors.
